items.title: The Bet Behind Fortinet's Rally
items.summary: Fortinet spent 2026 reporting strong cyber threat research, high demand for AI-focused security tools, and rising profitability, yet the biggest surprise sat in the share chart. Investors who held Fortinet from the start of the year are up 73.3%, including dividends. If you had been weighing the bullish calls against the cautious targets back on 1 January, what exactly in the business record would have justified taking that ride?
